roadmap.goal: Replace every eligible allocation through the approved driver-neutral predecessor-to-fresh-successor lifecycle while preserving stable WorkloadId policy ownership and exact existing effect owners.
roadmap.estimate_basis: Seven hours for the WorkloadLifecycle identity/ledger cut; twenty-four for the one action-shim production cut plus its direct, composed, reopen, Service, exit, stream, and qualified-metal evidence.

baseline.rejected_baseline: The restored pre-delivery implementation reuses suffix zero; the registered owner path observes [0,0], not [0,1,2], for Exec and VM.
impact_ranking: WorkloadLifecycle owns 14 pending pure/property bodies for identity selection, returned-View reservation, handoff, policy carry, placement, SystemGc, and allocation bounds.
The RestartAllocation action-shim arm owns the remaining 18 pending bodies because it currently conflates predecessor/successor identities and cleans the predecessor first.
The active Service terminal-preservation body remains a same-step regression control and receives no activation marker.
baseline.target_validation: Commit d00b1658 records semantic RED through real reconciler/runtime/shim owner paths and clean compilation; 730b7a removes only the obsolete same-ID bridge claim.

delivery_protocol: Execute in dependency order with a fresh isolated GPT-5.6 Luna/max crafter and reviewer per step; remediation returns only to that step's original agents.

Once these step IDs are finalized, the acceptance designer applies pending_body_activation_mappings before DELIVER; crafters then remove only their step-owned markers and preserve every authored body and oracle.
The feature delta pins the exact public/private contract. Any new action, API, port, store, schema, owner, retry, lock, driver policy, cleanup owner, or network mechanism is a blocker.
Each reviewer writes deliver/review-<step-id>.md with APPROVED before advancement. Rust tests never spawn the Overdrive binary or emit expectation evidence.
Mutation testing is excluded from every step and the final DELIVER gate by explicit user direction; do not run it or edit exclusions.

decomposition.rationale: The accepted design exposes exactly two production cuts. Splitting later evidence would create validation-only steps; splitting the shim would land a rejected cleanup-first intermediate contract.

rejected_simple_alternatives.expected_impact: Prevents only the reproduced VM artifact alias.
rejected_simple_alternatives.why_insufficient: It leaves Exec on same-ID replacement and makes WorkloadLifecycle identity policy driver-specific, contradicting ADR-0105.

rejected_simple_alternatives.expected_impact: Produces fresh successor identities in returned actions and Views.
rejected_simple_alternatives.why_insufficient: The current shim still cleans first and addresses successor work with the predecessor ID, failing ordering, publication, unwind, reopen composition, and host ownership.

phases.name: Driver-neutral allocation replacement
phases.description: Land the two accepted production cuts: driver-neutral WorkloadLifecycle identity/reservation policy, then exact successor-first action-shim ownership with all dependent evidence.

steps.name: Reserve driver-neutral successor identities
steps.description: Make WorkloadLifecycle return one fresh successor reservation for every eligible Exec or VM predecessor while preserving action shape, policy ownership, SystemGc placement, and checked exhaustion.
criteria: Eligible Exec and VM replacements emit RestartAllocation with numeric-current predecessor, distinct successor, matching successor SVID, and unchanged driver payload projection.
Only accepted numeric-current Failed or Terminated hands off replacement; Draining, historical terminal rows, and View-only reservations cannot become predecessors.
Workload Failure charges once; generation and Platform Reclamation carry policy; initial placement reserves zero and SystemGc remains fresh StartAllocation.
Allocation selects checked maximum-plus-one across accepted rows and returned-View ledger keys, ignores malformed suffixes, preserves gaps, issues MAX once, and never wraps.
Returned next View records each selected successor; later pure reconciliation advances above supplied ledger keys. Runtime fsync, reopen, and effect ordering remain step 01-02 obligations.

steps.name: Complete successor-first exact-ID ownership
steps.description: Correct the existing RestartAllocation shim arm so distinct successor work completes before one exact-old cleanup attempt, then prove durable reopen and every dependent Sim and host boundary.
criteria: After fencing accepted Failed or Terminated predecessor state, complete successor provision, launch, publication or unwind precedes one exact-old driver→mTLS→network cleanup attempt.
View fsync precedes successor effects; rejected publication consumes its reservation, fully unwinds, survives redb reopen, and later allocation advances above the gap for both drivers.
Fresh Running or Failed publication preserves predecessor rows/history, zeroes successor history, releases hooks/index only after accepted Running, and obeys the four-result precedence table.
Seeded Service, late-exit, and stream schedules preserve workload budgets, predecessor-scoped veto/history, fresh successor state, typed stream outcomes, and unrelated-allocation complements.
Qualified-metal execution proves exact-old cleanup cannot bind, remove, signal, or corrupt successor VM artifacts, rootfs, SVID/mTLS, process, cgroup, socket, or final cleanup.
